## Functional verification complete

Exact-head GitHub CI passes both governance and integration-regression jobs. Functional coverage now includes:

- dependency SHA/interface contract and repository governance checks;
- HFT order/account/product adapter and fail-closed policy;
- TAIFEX R02/R32 PositionEffect + `before_qty` metadata tap;
- long/short OPEN/CLOSE futures accounting v1;
- multi-account/multi-product futures state ownership;
- reset/recovery fail-closed behavior;
- 96-bit futures outstanding-order context over the frozen RMIC AMU contract;
- partial fill and remaining-quantity update;
- stale/duplicate quantity mismatch fail-closed behavior;
- next valid/replayed-then-committed fill applied once;
- IOC-style fill plus terminal release;
- cancel and reduce reservation release;
- R03 exchange-reject release and delete-once behavior;
- I2 OOC composition SystemVerilog compile-smoke.

The CI AMU stub validates only the integration wrapper contract. It is **not** evidence for hash collision behavior, XPM BRAM mapping, or physical timing. Those properties remain frozen-RMIC upstream evidence until the real-AMU I2 Vivado composition is measured.

## I2-04 remaining gate

The prepared OOC top is a physical-composition harness, not the final HFT production top. It combines:

```text
pinned RMIC XPM 8-bank AMU
  + futures order context
  + multi-account/product futures state manager
  + committed execution reconciliation bridge
```

Vivado sign-off command:

```powershell
pwsh .\scripts\run_i2_ooc_impl.ps1
```

Acceptance requires:

- actual RAMB36/RAMB18 use after synthesis;
- complete place/route;
- routed WNS >= 0 ns at 6.400 ns;
- TNS = 0;
- zero routing errors;
- reviewed utilization, DRC, critical path and vectorless power estimate.

The runner packages all reports/logs plus both frozen dependency SHAs into `build\packages\HFT_RMIC_i2_ooc_impl_*.zip`.

## Current claim limit

I2 functional correctness is established by self-checking simulation and exact-head CI. Integration OOC/post-route closure is **not yet established** until the local Vivado package is reviewed. No full HFT+RMIC datapath, board latency, live exchange behavior, TAIFEX SPAN implementation, or exchange conformance is claimed.
